# VO Batches — ElevenLabs-ready CSVs

**Generated by** `pnpm vo:generate-csv` (source: `apps/scripts/generate-vo-csv.ts`).
**Do not hand-edit.** Regenerate any time the source dialog modules change.

## Contents

Each file is one CSV per bundle per voice profile, ready to paste into
ElevenLabs Studio → Projects → Import CSV, or to feed the
`generate-{character}-vo.ts` single-speaker pipelines.

| File | Source module | What it covers |
|---|---|---|
| `companion-comments__elara.csv` | `apps/shared/companionComments.ts` | Elara's reactive one-shot lines (music triggers, Kael reveal, prelude beats, Acts 2–7 once those PRs merge) |
| `companion-comments__human.csv` | `apps/shared/companionComments.ts` | The Human's reactive one-shot lines |
| `companion-ask-topics__elara.csv` | `apps/shared/companionAskTopics.ts` | Elara's authored answers to re-enterable Ask topics |
| `companion-ask-topics__human.csv` | `apps/shared/companionAskTopics.ts` | The Human's authored answers to re-enterable Ask topics |
| `act1-opponent-dialog__elara.csv` | `apps/shared/act1OpponentDialog.ts` | Elara's per-opponent pre/post-match lines for the 12 Act 1 opponents |
| `act1-opponent-dialog__human.csv` | `apps/shared/act1OpponentDialog.ts` | The Human's per-opponent pre/post-match lines |
| `act1-opponent-dialog__antiquarian.csv` | `apps/shared/act1OpponentDialog.ts` | Engineer-memoir framing + opponent-voice taunts (placeholder voice — per-opponent VO reassigns these downstream) |

## CSV column contract

```
id,character,voice_profile,stability,similarity,style,speaker_boost,text,direction,priority
```

- `id` — globally unique line id (pattern varies by bundle; see rows)
- `character` — human-readable speaker (quoted)
- `voice_profile` — ElevenLabs voice slot (unquoted; matches generate-{profile}-vo.ts conventions)
- `stability`, `similarity`, `style` — float 0–1, set per-voice in `VOICE_SETTINGS`
- `speaker_boost` — boolean, unquoted (`true`/`false`)
- `text` — the line itself, CSV-quoted with doubled inner quotes. May contain ElevenLabs SSML (`<break time="500ms"/>`, `<emphasis>…</emphasis>`)
- `direction` — voice-actor direction, CSV-quoted, ≤180 chars
- `priority` — `P0`/`P1`/`P2`, unquoted, controlled by `--priority` flag

## Regeneration

```bash
# Default output
pnpm vo:generate-csv

# Override priority (e.g. for ship-blocker batches)
pnpm vo:generate-csv --priority P0

# Write somewhere else
pnpm vo:generate-csv --output-dir path/to/dir
```

The script is deterministic — two runs against the same source modules
produce byte-identical CSVs, which keeps PRs against these files noise-free.

## When a CSV changes

When any of the source `apps/shared/*` dialog modules change, regenerate
this directory and commit the updated CSVs alongside the source change.
The vitest smoke test at `apps/shared/generate-vo-csv.test.ts` only
validates shape; it does not compare against the checked-in CSVs, so the
regeneration step is a human responsibility at authoring time.
